summary.text: The nine-five sovereign immortal aperture is Fang Yuan's rank six blessed land formed by sovereign immortal fetus Gu.

claims.text: The aperture has ten layers, each over 33500 km2. The first layer is land split into five areas: a fertile central zone with varied terrain, a moist foggy southern mountain zone, a windy northern grassland, an eastern sea of countless islands like a chessboard, and a hot western desert. Layers two through ten hold no soil and are colored red, orange, yellow, green, azure, blue, purple, white, and black.

After failing to catch Ying Wu Xie, Fang Yuan lands on a Southern Border mountain and looks into the new immortal aperture. He finds space that far exceeds ordinary grades. Most rank six blessed lands reach at most about six thousand km2, and even a ten extreme physique super grade aperture stays under thirteen thousand km2 at the start.

Deviation (recorded): this page uses the Southern Border region field because Fang Yuan first inspects the aperture while still in Southern Border after the Yi Tian Mountain battle. The aperture is carried in his body and is not a five-region map pin.

His aperture has ten layers, each over 33500 km2, for more than 335000 km2 in total. The first layer is land split into five areas that match the five regions: a fertile central zone, a moist southern mountain zone, a windy northern grassland, an eastern sea of islands, and a hot western desert. Layers two through ten hold no soil and are colored red, orange, yellow, green, azure, blue, purple, white, and black, matching the immemorial nine heavens. Fang Yuan reads nine heavens and five regions in that layout as the reason sovereign immortal fetus Gu carries the nine-five sovereign name.

A later overnight inspection confirms over 335000 km2 of space and a time ratio of one outer day to two months inside, or one to sixty, higher than Hei Lou Lan’s one to thirty-eight Great Strength True Martial Physique aperture. The living aperture produces sixteen beads of green grape immortal essence a day.

His body holds many paths of dao marks at roughly a hundred each on average, yet mortal Gu of different paths do not weaken one another as common sense expects. He also finds no vital Gu in the aperture.
That daily production is not enough for some of Fang Yuan’s sword path activations that burn over a hundred beads each.
Deeper inspection shows he can cultivate every path without dao mark conflict, which ordinary Gu Immortals and even venerables do not enjoy when they try to hold many paths at once.

He later names the layers with a “Mini” prefix, such as Mini Northern Plains and Mini Eastern Sea, and finds their environments close to the outer world, including different dao mark leanings by area.

Daily production is also counted as ninety-six beads per year of aperture time. Fang Yuan treats the aperture’s space and fast resource growth as the reason he can support large numbers of Immortal Gu.
